const SCRAMBLE_CHARS='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789#%&@$*+=<>/\\|▓▒░█';
function scrambleText(el, dur=900){
  const final = el.dataset.final ?? (el.dataset.final = el.textContent);
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){ el.textContent=final; el.classList.add('decoded'); return; }
  const start=performance.now();
  el.classList.add('scrambling');
  function frame(now){
    const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/dur);
    const reveal=Math.floor(final.length*t);
    let out='';
    for(let i=0;i<final.length;i++){
      const ch=final[i];
      if(i<reveal || ch===' ') out+=ch;
      else out+=SCRAMBLE_CHARS[(Math.random()*SCRAMBLE_CHARS.length)|0];
    }
    el.textContent=out;
    if(t<1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    else { el.textContent=final; el.classList.remove('scrambling'); el.classList.add('decoded'); }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function observeScrambles(root=document){
  const els=root.querySelectorAll('[data-scramble]:not(.decoded)');
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){els.forEach(e=>scrambleText(e,0));return;}
  const io=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){scrambleText(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{threshold:0.4});
  els.forEach(e=>io.observe(e));
}

/* Engine: cursor-lit lattice + scroll-driven jacket pose + hand-tracking layers. */
function startConcept(){
  if(typeof window.__conceptStop === 'function'){ window.__conceptStop(); window.__conceptStop = null; }

  const root = document.getElementById('concept');
  const cv   = document.getElementById('concept-lattice');
  const jacket = document.getElementById('concept-jacket');
  const outer = document.getElementById('cj-outer');
  const inner = document.getElementById('cj-inner');
  if(!root || !cv || !jacket) return;

  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const CELL = 46;
  const heat = new Map();          // cell key -> glow value, decays each frame
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  let px = -9999, py = -9999, hasPointer = false;
  let cx = 0, cy = 0;              // cursor normalized -1..1
  let oX=0,oY=0,oRX=0,oRY=0;       // outer layer (fast lerp — turns to your hand)
  let iRY=0, iRZ=0, prevRY=0;      // inner layer (slow lerp — sleeves trail behind)
  let raf = 0, running = true;

  /* Per-screen poses: where the jacket stands on each screen. */
  const POSES = [
    {x: 27, y:  5, r: -8, s:0.92, o:1},
    {x:-27, y: -3, r:  7, s:1.00, o:1},
    {x: 23, y:  3, r: -5, s:0.86, o:1},
    {x: 17, y:  0, r:  5, s:1.06, o:0.5}
  ];

  const resize = ()=>{
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
    W = cv.clientWidth; H = cv.clientHeight;
    cv.width = Math.round(W*dpr); cv.height = Math.round(H*dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  };

  const move = e=>{
    const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    px = e.clientX - r.left; py = e.clientY - r.top; hasPointer = true;
    cx = (e.clientX/window.innerWidth)*2 - 1;
    cy = (e.clientY/window.innerHeight)*2 - 1;
  };

  const progress = ()=>{
    const top = root.offsetTop;
    const span = Math.max(1, root.offsetHeight - window.innerHeight);
    return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (window.scrollY - top)/span));
  };

  const frame = ()=>{
    if(!running) return;
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    /* decay previous glow */
    heat.forEach((v,k)=>{ v *= 0.93; if(v<0.03) heat.delete(k); else heat.set(k,v); });
    /* ignite cells under the cursor */
    if(hasPointer && !reduce){
      const gx = Math.floor(px/CELL), gy = Math.floor(py/CELL), R = 3;
      for(let dx=-R;dx<=R;dx++) for(let dy=-R;dy<=R;dy++){
        const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy); if(d>R) continue;
        const k = (gx+dx)+'_'+(gy+dy);
        const v = Math.exp(-d*d/4.2);
        if(v > (heat.get(k)||0)) heat.set(k, v);
      }
    }

    /* draw lattice */
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=CELL){ ctx.moveTo(x+0.5,0); ctx.lineTo(x+0.5,H); }
    for(let y=0;y<=H;y+=CELL){ ctx.moveTo(0,y+0.5); ctx.lineTo(W,y+0.5); }
    ctx.stroke();
    heat.forEach((v,k)=>{
      const p = k.split('_');
      const ix = (+p[0])*CELL, iy = (+p[1])*CELL;
      if(ix < -CELL || iy < -CELL || ix > W || iy > H) return;
      const hue = 262 + (((+p[0])*7 + (+p[1])*5) % 62);   /* violet → magenta sweep */
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla('+hue+',100%,62%,'+(v*0.5).toFixed(3)+')';
      ctx.fillRect(ix+2, iy+2, CELL-4, CELL-4);
      if(v>0.55){
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla('+hue+',100%,78%,'+((v-0.55)*1.6).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.strokeRect(ix+2.5, iy+2.5, CELL-5, CELL-5);
      }
    });

    /* travel pose — interpolate between screens with smoothstep */
    const prog = progress();
    const seg = prog*(POSES.length-1);
    const i = Math.min(POSES.length-2, Math.floor(seg));
    const f = seg - i;
    const e = f*f*(3-2*f);
    const a = POSES[i], b = POSES[i+1];
    const X = a.x+(b.x-a.x)*e, Y = a.y+(b.y-a.y)*e;
    const Rr = a.r+(b.r-a.r)*e, S = a.s+(b.s-a.s)*e, O = a.o+(b.o-a.o)*e;
    jacket.style.transform = 'translate(-50%,-50%) translate('+X.toFixed(2)+'vw,'+Y.toFixed(2)+'vh) rotate('+Rr.toFixed(2)+'deg) scale('+S.toFixed(3)+')';
    jacket.style.opacity = O.toFixed(3);

    if(!reduce){
      /* outer: turns to your hand */
      oX  += (cx*16 - oX)*0.12;
      oY  += (cy*12 - oY)*0.12;
      oRY += (cx*16 - oRY)*0.12;
      oRX += (-cy*9 - oRX)*0.12;
      outer.style.transform = 'translate3d('+oX.toFixed(2)+'px,'+oY.toFixed(2)+'px,0) rotateX('+oRX.toFixed(2)+'deg) rotateY('+oRY.toFixed(2)+'deg)';
      /* inner: sleeves trail a beat behind (follows slowly, so it lags the outer) */
      iRY += (oRY - iRY)*0.045;
      const vel = oRY - prevRY; prevRY = oRY;
      iRZ += (vel*0.55 - iRZ)*0.06;
      const lag = Math.max(-7, Math.min(7, oRY - iRY));
      inner.style.transform = 'rotateZ('+iRZ.toFixed(2)+'deg) rotateY('+lag.toFixed(2)+'deg) translateX('+(lag*1.6).toFixed(2)+'px)';
    }
  };

  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', move, {passive:true});
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

  window.__conceptStop = ()=>{
    running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
    window.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
  };
}

function ensureCatalogDelta(){
  let changed = false;
  STORE_CATEGORIES.forEach(cat=>{
    if(!DB.categories.some(c=>c.id===cat.id)){
      DB.categories.push({id:cat.id, name:cat.name, coverImage:cat.coverImage||null});

    }
  });
  Object.keys(STORE_PRODUCTS).forEach(catId=>{
    const cat = STORE_CATEGORIES.find(c=>c.id===catId);
    if(!cat) return;
    STORE_PRODUCTS[catId].forEach(it=>{
      if(!it.id) return;                       /* only explicitly-identified items */
      if(DB.products.some(p=>p.id===it.id)) return;
      DB.products.push({
        id:it.id, title:it.title, category:catId, categoryName:cat.name,
        price:it.price, discountPrice:it.discountPrice??null,
        colors:it.colors||['black','white','navy','beige'],
        sizes:it.sizes||['S','M','L','XL','2XL'],
        images:it.images||[generateProductImage(catId, it.id)],
        rating:it.rating||'4.6', reviewsCount:it.reviewsCount||(18+it.title.length),
        stock:it.stock??20, tags:it.tags||['new'],
        description:it.description||`A NoFrame signature ${cat.name.toLowerCase()} piece cut from premium materials, designed for everyday sophistication and effortless style.`,
        createdAt:Date.now()-(hashStr(it.id)%20)*86400000
      });
      changed = true;
    });
  });
  if(changed){
    try{ localStorage.setItem('noframe-db-fallback', JSON.stringify(DB)); }catch(e){ console.warn(e); }
  }
}

## Admin access control (RBAC)

- The **Admin Portal** footer link only renders for accounts whose `role` is `admin`.
- `#/admin` is also guarded in the router: a signed-in customer who opens the URL
  directly is sent back to the home page ("Access denied").
- Hiding the link is not the protection. `api/api.php` enforces it server-side:
  `?action=save` requires an admin JWT (403 otherwise), and `?action=load`
  returns the customer directory and the **full** order book only to admins.
  A signed-in customer receives only their own orders; guests receive none.
- Orders are written through `?action=create_order`, which always stores the
  order under the authenticated account (or as a guest order) — the client
  cannot attach an order to somebody else's account.

## First-order discount PIN

Every first-time sign-up (email **or** Google) gets a PIN such as
`NF-PQ9D-UTUA`, shown on the thank-you screen and stored on the customer's
profile page (and in the `users.discount_pin` column when that column exists).

## Google sign-up

Google sign-up is wired up but disabled until you add an OAuth client ID:

1. Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID → **Web application**
2. Add your origin (e.g. `http://localhost/`) to *Authorised JavaScript origins*
3. Paste the client ID in **both** `js/app.js` (`GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`) and
   `api/config.php` (`GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`)

The server verifies the ID token against Google's `tokeninfo` endpoint
(signature, issuer, audience, expiry) before creating or opening an account;
new Google accounts are created with role `customer`.

## Why you couldn't log in

Your site is being served by the **static preview server on port 8080** (`py -m http.server`), not XAMPP — port 80 has no server running right now. A static server cannot execute PHP, so the login POST returns **501**, and the app correctly falls back to its browser-side database. That fallback only contained the demo customer, so `admin@store.com` didn't exist there and sign-in was rejected with "Invalid email or password".

The console proves it exactly: `API 501 → API login failed, using fallback authentication`.

## The fix

Added `ensureSeedAdmins()` to [app.js](js/app.js) — it mirrors the two administrators from [noframe.sql](database/noframe.sql) into the offline fallback database on start-up, the same way the demo customer has always worked. Assets bumped to `?v=20261028`.

```js
function compressImageFile(file, cb){
  if(!file.type.startsWith('image/')){ toast('Please choose an image file'); return; }
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = e => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      const MAX = 800;
      let scale = Math.min(1, MAX/Math.max(img.width, img.height));
      let w = Math.round(img.width*scale), h = Math.round(img.height*scale);
      const tryEncode = (quality) => {
        const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
        cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
        return cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
      };
      let q = 0.72, data = tryEncode(q);
      while(data.length > 55000 && q > 0.35){ q -= 0.12; data = tryEncode(q); }
      if(data.length > 55000 && (w>400||h>400)){ shrink and retry loop }
      ...
    };
    img.src = e.target.result;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}
```

/* ---------------- ADMIN: top bar, table links, product search ---------------- */
.admin-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px;}
.admin-topbar-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ap-search{
  min-width:260px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:#FFFFFF;
  padding:11px 14px;font-size:13px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);outline:none;
}
.ap-search:focus{border-color:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(112,0,255,0.22);}
.icon-link{cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;margin-right:12px;background:none;border:0;padding:0;font-family:inherit;}
.icon-link:hover{color:var(--violet);}
.icon-link.danger{color:#FF6B6B;}
.icon-link.danger:hover{color:#FF9B9B;}

/* ---------------- ADMIN: product photo field ---------------- */
.pf-photo{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pf-photo-preview{
  width:112px;height:112px;flex:0 0 auto;border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-alt);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.pf-photo-preview::after{content:'No photo';font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.pf-photo-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.pf-photo-tools{flex:1;min-width:240px;}
.pf-photo-tools input{
  width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;
  background:var(--surface-alt);color:#FFFFFF;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);outline:none;
}
.pf-photo-tools input:focus{border-color:var(--violet);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(112,0,255,0.22);}
.pf-photo-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 2px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pf-upload{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;}
.pf-upload input[type=file]{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;}
.pf-upload:hover{border-color:var(--violet);}

/* ---------------- STOREFRONT: admin edit bar on a product page ---------------- */
.pd-admin-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;

  padding:10px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin-bottom:20px;
}
.pd-admin-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;background:var(--violet);color:#FFFFFF;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;}
.pd-admin-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);flex:1;min-width:160px;}

+/* The MySQL `images` column is TEXT (64 KB), so an uploaded photo must be
+   stored as a compact JPEG data-URL well under that limit. */
+const PF_PHOTO_MAX_CHARS = 55000;
+
+function pfCurrentPhoto(){
+  const inp = document.getElementById('pf-image');
+  const url = inp ? inp.value.trim() : '';
+  return url || VIEW.pfUpload || '';
+}
+function pfPreviewPhoto(){
+  const img = document.getElementById('pf-photo-img');
+  if(!img) return;
+  const src = pfCurrentPhoto();
+  if(!src){ img.style.display='none'; img.removeAttribute('src'); return; }
+  img.style.display='';
+  if(img.getAttribute('src') !== src) img.src = src;
+}
+function pfUploadPhoto(input){
+  const f = input && input.files && input.files[0];
+  if(f) pfApplyPhoto(f, input);
+}
+function pfApplyPhoto(file, inputEl){
+  if(!file || !file.type || !file.type.startsWith('image/')){ toast('Please choose an image file'); return; }
+  compressPhoto(file, (dataUrl, err)=>{
+    if(!dataUrl){ toast(err || 'Could not read that image'); return; }
+    VIEW.pfUpload = dataUrl;
+    const inp = document.getElementById('pf-image');
+    if(inp){ inp.value=''; inp.placeholder='Uploaded photo in use — paste a URL to replace it'; }
+    pfPreviewPhoto();
+    if(inputEl) inputEl.value='';   /* allow re-picking the same file */
+    toast('Photo added ✓ — press Save Product to apply it');
+  });
+}
+function pfRemoveUpload(btn){
+  VIEW.pfUpload = null;
+  if(btn && btn.parentNode) btn.parentNode.removeChild(btn);
+  pfPreviewPhoto();
+}
+function compressPhoto(file, cb){
+  const reader = new FileReader();
+  reader.onerror = ()=>cb(null,'Could not read that file');
+  reader.onload = e=>{
+    const img = new Image();
+    img.onerror = ()=>cb(null,'That file is not a usable image');
+    img.onload = ()=>{
+      if(!img.width || !img.height){ cb(null,'That file is not a usable image'); return; }
+      const scale = Math.min(1, 800/Math.max(img.width, img.height));
+      let w = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width*scale));
+      let h = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height*scale));
+      let q = 0.72;
+      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
+      const cx = cv.getContext('2d');
+      const encode = ()=>{
+        cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
+        cx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF'; cx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);   /* JPEG has no alpha */
+        cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
+        return cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', Math.max(0.3, q));
+      };
+      let out = '', guard = 0;
+      do {
+        try{ out = encode(); }
+        catch(err){ cb(null,'Could not encode that photo'); return; }
+        if(out.length <= PF_PHOTO_MAX_CHARS) break;
+        if(q > 0.4){ q -= 0.1; }
+        else if(w > 200){ w = Math.round(w*0.8); h = Math.round(h*0.8); q = 0.6; }
+        else { break; }
+      } while(guard++ < 24);
+      if(out.length > PF_PHOTO_MAX_CHARS){ cb(null,'That photo is too large to store — try a smaller image'); return; }
+      cb(out);
+    };
+    img.src = e.target.result;
+  };
+  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
+}

+        colors:it.colors||['black','white'], sizes:it.sizes||['S','M','L','XL'],

function hasPurchased(productId){

All ten items are built and verified in the browser. Here's where things stand.

## What changed

**1. Signup/login no longer shows stored history data** — [js/app.js](js/app.js)
- The pre-filled `demo@noframe.com` / `demo123` values and the "Demo account pre-filled" line are gone from the login form.
- Added autocomplete hygiene so a returning browser can't pour saved data into a new account form: passwords are `new-password`, the mobile field is `autocomplete="off"`, name/email use their standard tokens.

**2. Google sign-in** — the whole flow (button, token verification against Google, account creation, discount PIN) already existed but both configs were empty. On both the Login and Sign Up tabs you now get a real Google button labelled *Sign in / Sign up with Google*, plus a visible setup note instead of a dead control that only toasted. **To switch it on:** paste your OAuth Client ID into `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` in [js/app.js](js/app.js) and in [api/config.php](api/config.php) — steps are in [README_XAMPP.md](README_XAMPP.md) → *Google sign-up* (Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID → Web application → add your origin to Authorised JavaScript origins).

**3. Optional profile photo** — [js/app.js](js/app.js), [api/api.php](api/api.php)
- Profile → Personal & Contact Details now has an upload/remove picture control, explicitly marked optional. The photo is auto-resized, posted to a new `upload_avatar` endpoint, saved under `assets/avatars/`, and shows in the header avatar immediately. With PHP down it still works (kept in that browser).

**4. Admin → Orders, arranged by date with price detail** — orders sort **newest first** (toggle to oldest), with a stat strip (orders / product value / delivery / order value) and columns Date, Subtotal, Delivery, Total. Clicking any row opens the full detail: photo, name, colour/size, qty × price, line total, then **Date → Subtotal → Delivery → Total → Status → Deliver to** top to bottom. Recent Orders on the dashboard is date-sorted too.

**5. Code part updates after you enter products** — [api/api.php](api/api.php)
- New **"⇪ Update data/catalog.js"** button in Admin → Products writes the whole catalogue back into [data/catalog.js](data/catalog.js) (admin-only; the old file is kept as `.bak`).
- The same sync also runs silently after every product save/delete, so the file keeps matching the panel. Without PHP running, the button downloads `catalog.js` for you to drop in by hand.

**6. Christmas Santa display moved to the left corner** — [css/style.css](css/style.css) (`right` → `left`, including the mobile rule).

**7. Product Q&A + a new admin section** — [js/app.js](js/app.js), [api/api.php](api/api.php)
- Product page has a **Questions & Answers** block: signed-in shoppers type a question, it shows as Q with an "awaiting reply" note until you answer.
- New **Questions** item in the admin sidebar (with an unanswered counter), each row showing product photo, item, who asked, when, the question, your reply and a reply box. Whatever you post appears straight away on the product page. Storage is a new `product_questions` table, created automatically on first use.

**8. Feedback only from people who bought it** — the review form is now gated: signed-in non-buyers see "Only customers who have bought this can leave feedback", signed-out visitors get a sign-in link, and buyers get a **1–5 star picker** plus their name pre-filled. The check also runs inside `submitReview`, so it can't be bypassed from the console.

**9. Order history with photos** — each order in Profile → My Orders is now a card with a thumbnail strip of the ordered photos, and every line shows its picture, title, colour/size, `price × qty`, line total, then subtotal → delivery → total paid, with date and status in the header.

Asset versions bumped to `?v=20261030`.

## Verified
Ran it on a local PHP server (`127.0.0.1:8090`, registered as the thread preview): 218 products / 17 categories intact, no pre-fill on either auth tab, Google button + note on both tabs, avatar upload → header update → remove → default restored, admin orders sorted and expanding correctly, the Q&A round-trip (ask → admin reply → answer on the product page), the buyer gate in all three states (buyer / non-buyer / signed out), order cards with photos and price totals, and the generated `catalog.js` text parses as valid JS with all 17 categories and 218 products. `php -l` passes on `api/api.php` and `api/config.php`. Test orders/questions I created during verification were removed.

## One blocker you need to fix
The PHP API returns **HTTP 500**: `SQLSTATE[HY000] [1045] Access denied for user 'root'@'localhost' (using password: NO)` — a MySQL *is* listening on 3306, but it rejects the credentials in [api/config.php](api/config.php) (`root` with an empty `$DB_PASS`). Put your actual XAMPP MySQL password in `$DB_PASS` (or start XAMPP's own MySQL if another instance is holding port 3306) and the API, Google sign-in, questions, avatar upload and catalog sync all go live. Until then everything above still works through the browser-local database, which is how I tested it. Also pre-existing: the home hero requests `images/hero-video.mp4`/`.webm`, but the file in the folder is `promo-video.mp4` — say the word and I'll point it at the right file.
